title: Ada Lovelace
text: Ada Lovelace wrote extensive notes about Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine. Her notes included an algorithm intended to be carried out by the machine.

title: Charles Babbage
text: Charles Babbage designed the Analytical Engine, a proposed general-purpose mechanical computer. Ada Lovelace collaborated with Babbage by writing notes about the machine.

title: Grace Hopper
text: Grace Hopper was a computer scientist who helped develop early compilers. She was not involved in the Analytical Engine.
